title: Keep CommandCenterUI Needs you header visible when empty
description: Keep the collapsible Needs you sidebar header visible when there are zero attention items, showing a zero count while leaving the history body collapsed by default. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Needs you header remains visible with a zero count when no attention items exist.
Attention history remains collapsible and live/template parity with focused checks pass.
